story.title: The Great Tomato Launchpad
story.question: How did Barnaby sell out of his entire vegetable harvest before noon?
story.answer: He invented an automated pneumatic catapult that precisely tossed tomatoes directly into shoppers' grocery bags.

story_beats.headline: The Market Chaos
story_beats.speech: My fellow stallholders are laughing, but soon every single ripe tomato will find its grateful buyer instantly.
story_beats.label: The Discovery
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby standing in a crowded noisy medieval market square next to a massive wooden robotic catapult, holding a clipboard with a worried expression, wearing a tweed vest and leather goggles, while nearby fruit vendors point and laugh at his bizarre contraption.

story_beats.headline: Engineering the Launch
story_beats.speech: We just need a bit more tension on the rubber springs to achieve maximum market penetration velocity.
story_beats.label: The Assembly
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby in his cluttered stall workshop tightening a complex network of brass gears and rubber bands on the pneumatic launcher, holding a heavy wrench with a determined smile, surrounded by scattered green tomatoes and fluttering instruction scrolls.

story_beats.headline: The Trigger Mechanism
story_beats.speech: Watch closely as the acoustic sensor locks onto the sound of clinking coin purses and fires.
story_beats.label: The Operation
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby pointing proudly at a swinging wooden trapdoor on the launcher that aims directly at the bustling marketplace entrance, holding a brass megaphone while an inquisitive customer approaches holding a coin purse.

story_beats.headline: The Triumphant Payoff
story_beats.speech: Look at that! Perfectly delivered, perfectly caught, and my pockets are overflowing with golden coins!
story_beats.label: The Success
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby standing atop his fully operational pneumatic launcher shaped vaguely like an airship hull, holding an empty crate in one hand and a bulging bag of gold coins in the other, while cheering shoppers hold up fresh tomatoes caught mid-air.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colourful stop-motion animation aesthetic with detailed textures, rustic wooden props, and a lively comedic atmosphere.

characters.Barnaby: An eccentric inventor with unruly grey hair, wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a brown tweed vest, rolled-up white shirt sleeves, and leather utility gloves.

locations.market_square: A bustling, sunlit cobblestone marketplace filled with colourful striped vendor awnings, wooden crates, and milling townspeople in rustic medieval-style clothing.
locations.workshop_stall: A cramped market stall overflowing with loose gears, blueprints, hanging lanterns, and heaps of fresh red tomatoes.

objects.pneumatic_launcher: A large, complex machine constructed from dark polished oak wood, brass pipes, thick black rubber bands, and a mechanical aiming dial.
objects.gold_coin_pouch: A small weathered leather drawstring bag jingling with heavy metallic currency.
objects.brass_wrench: A heavy, tarnished antique tool used for tightening machine bolts.

story.title: The Mechanical Sausage Slinger Disaster
story.hook: A Sticky Situation at Stall Four
story.question: How did Barnaby turn a noisy market squabble into a sizzling success?
story.answer: By inventing a fully automated meat-missile dispenser that seasoned every flying link on impact.

story_beats.headline: A Sticky Situation at Stall Four
story_beats.speech: Behold my magnificent mechanized meat launcher, designed to feed hungry shoppers faster than they can blink!
story_beats.label: The Invention Reveal
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby stands proudly behind a brass and wood contraption in a crowded medieval market square, gesturing wildly with a greasy wrench while startled shoppers duck away from a hovering metal arm.

story_beats.headline: Gearing Up for Launch
story_beats.speech: We must tighten these primary tension springs and load three hundred spicy sausages into the firing chamber immediately!
story_beats.label: Loading the Mechanism
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby frantically cranks a large iron wheel on the side of the machine, while his nervous apprentice Pip frantically stuffs long strings of raw sausages into a gaping hopper.

story_beats.headline: The Sizzling Signal
story_beats.speech: When the glowing brass dial hits the red zone, release the emergency seasoning lever and duck for cover!
story_beats.label: Activating the Launch
story_beats.visual_prompt: A bright red flare shoots upward from the top of the machine, casting a fiery glow over Barnaby and Pip as steam hisses from copper pipes and sausage links begin to vibrate inside.

story_beats.headline: A Town Full of Tacos
story_beats.speech: Look at them soar across the plaza! Every single customer caught a perfectly grilled breakfast right in their buns!
story_beats.label: The Delicious Payoff
story_beats.visual_prompt: Barnaby and Pip stand in the doorway of their smoke-filled shop grinning broadly as ecstatic market patrons cheerfully wave freshly grilled sausages caught mid-air from the sky above.

visual_bible.style: Bright, colorful, whimsical slapstick animation style with exaggerated expressions and detailed steampunk machinery.

characters.Barnaby: A stout, enthusiastic inventor with bushy gray hair, smudged soot on his cheeks, wearing a worn leather apron over a striped vest.
characters.Pip: A hyperactive young apprentice with freckles, oversized goggles perched on his forehead, wearing an oversized blue tunic.

locations.Market Square: A bustling, sunlit cobblestone marketplace filled with striped canvas awnings, wooden carts piled high with vegetables, and cheerful townsfolk.

objects.Meat Launcher: A towering contraption made of gleaming brass pipes, wooden crates, ticking clockwork gears, and a large metal hopper.
objects.Sausage String: A continuous chain of plump, pink raw sausages tied tightly together with thick cotton twine.
objects.Seasoning Lever: A bright red wooden lever attached to a spring-loaded iron hinge covered in dried paprika.

story.title: The Last Ridge Beacon
story.question: Can a frozen rescue team guide a lost climber through a blizzard using only sound?
story.answer: Yes, by bouncing acoustic pulses off canyon walls to map a safe path to the shelter.

story_beats.headline: The Silent Storm
story_beats.speech: Listen carefully to the echoes bouncing off the gorge walls. That unique double ring is your only way out of this blinding whiteout.
story_beats.label: Acoustic Mapping
story_beats.visual_prompt: In a snowy mountain pass, female rescue leader Maya in a heavy red parka holds an active sonar emitter broadcasting blue soundwaves toward towering icy cliffs during a heavy blizzard.

story_beats.headline: Climbing the Soundwaves
story_beats.speech: Keep your boots steady on the packed snow ridge. Follow the rising frequency until the pitch matches the horn in your left hand.
story_beats.label: Pine Ridge Trail
story_beats.visual_prompt: Climber Leo in a blue insulated jacket navigates a steep pine forest path covered in thick snow, holding a mechanical tuning fork that glows faintly as he listens to the distant rescue signals.

story_beats.headline: The Cleft Obstacle
story_beats.speech: A massive snowdrift blocks the direct path ahead. We must redirect the acoustic wave around the frozen pillar to find the hidden cabin door.
story_beats.label: Blocked Passage
story_beats.visual_prompt: Maya stands beside a massive ice wall holding a metallic reflector dish, angling it to bounce a visible sound pulse around a dangerous crevasse toward a recessed wooden shelter door.

story_beats.headline: Safe Inside
story_beats.speech: You followed the acoustic path right to the threshold. Come inside where it is warm and safe out of this fierce mountain wind.
story_beats.label: Rescue Shelter
story_beats.visual_prompt: Inside a secure domed emergency shelter resembling a futuristic metal pod, Maya welcomes a relieved Leo, handing him a steaming thermal flask while the blizzard rages harmlessly outside.

visual_bible.style: Cinematic realism with dramatic lighting, crisp mountain textures, and vibrant colored visual wave effects.

characters.Maya: A seasoned female mountain rescue leader with a determined expression, wearing a heavy red parka, black snow pants, and a warm woolen beanie.
characters.Leo: A stranded hiker with tired eyes and frost-kissed cheeks, wearing a blue insulated jacket, waterproof trousers, and heavy hiking boots.

locations.Mountain_Pass: A treacherous, high-altitude alpine environment covered in deep snow drifts, towering jagged cliffs, and thick pine trees.
locations.Emergency_Shelter: A sturdy, dome-shaped metal rescue pod embedded into the mountainside with a reinforced heavy wooden door and warm interior lighting.

objects.Sonar_Emitter: A handheld silver metallic device with a glowing blue digital screen and a directional horn used for generating acoustic mapping pulses.
objects.Tuning_Fork: A brass-handled acoustic instrument that vibrates and emits a soft golden hum when detecting the rescue signal.
objects.Thermal_Flask: A rugged steel thermos painted dark green, filled with hot herbal tea and held by a screwed-on plastic cup.
